topic: SEC-part5 — ISS-2463 self-apply verification: ks-tldr + Summary 78→73% (q448)
change_summary: Decider self-applied ISS-2463: Part5 ks-tldr (idx 20602/20773) and Part5 Summary paragraph (idx 24828) both changed from "failed by 78% on Sydney–Buenos Aires" → "failed by 73% on Sydney–Buenos Aires", closing the residual cross-section inconsistency from ISS-2456 that KILLSHOT-SH.c3 (q444) had flagged as PARTIAL.
our_argument_summary: Part 5 is the Kill Shots tab. SH (Sydney-Hyderabad / Sydney–Perth railway / V13 coordinate critique) is the kill-shot in scope. The patch chain (ISS-2456 → ISS-2463) consolidates the dome's V12 forward-computation error on the Sydney–Buenos Aires (SYD–EZE) cross-equatorial benchmark at 73% (3,194 km predicted vs ~11,800 km actual), matching the §6.10 / §7.1 derivation. Prior to ISS-2463 the part5 ks-tldr and Summary paragraph still carried the older 78% figure (tied to a deprecated 2,600 km V12 estimate), creating a cross-section inconsistency with §6.10 / §7.1. This verification confirms both patches landed.

This is the SBA-specific number — NOT the 25–78% range quote — and it is now the lone hold-out at 78% while Part 5 (ks-tldr idx 20773, body idx 23509, Summary idx 24828), Part 6 (idx 63033), and Part 7 (idx 1639, 1675, 1744) all read 73%. The four legitimate 25–78% range quotes (part2 idx 56510, part7 idx 1780 and 3114, WIN-057 detail_claim) all cite the dome's own self-reported diagnosis range and should stay.

deeper_analysis: Part 5 internal consistency is now clean: four 73% occurrences in part5.html (idx 20773 ks-tldr; idx 21945 dome-quoted 32–73% range; idx 23509 body forward-computation; idx 24828 Summary). Zero 78% occurrences in part5. ks-tldr context confirms verbatim landing: "Its predecessor (V12) failed by 73% on Sydney–Buenos Aires; V13 claims −8.4% via unpublished scaling parameters that cannot be independently verified." Summary context confirms verbatim landing: "failed by 73% on Sydney-Buenos Aires in V12, claims 8.4% in V13 via unpublished scaling functions". Cross-section scan (all sections.json + wins.json): five sites at 73% on SBA (part5 ×3, part6 ×1, part7 ×3 counting the 73% references in 1639/1675/1744), and one site still at 78% on SBA (part8 §8.2 idx 1875). The four 25–78% range quotes (part2 idx 56510; part7 idx 1780, 3114; WIN-057 detail_claim) are direct quotes of the dome's own published diagnosis range and are not inconsistencies — they should stay. The docs/index.html line 4925 carries the same part8 78% string (sections → docs flows through build.js), so a sections.json patch + rebuild closes both.

advocate_mode.strongest_dome_response: A dome defender does not actually need to engage the 73% number itself — they can simply point to "your own Part 8 says 78%, your own Part 5 says 73%, you can't keep your own review consistent." This is rhetorically powerful because (a) it requires no math, (b) it implicitly questions every other number we cite, (c) it shifts the burden back to us. The legitimate dome counter-response on the SUBSTANCE — "the V12 formula was a draft, V13 is the published one, judging us by V12 forward computation is unfair" — is weaker than the inconsistency attack because we already preempt it (§7.1 documents the V12→V13 transition; V13 introduces three unpublished free parameters precisely to fit SYD-EZE).
advocate_mode.weakest_link_in_our_argument: The single residual 78% in part8. Fix it and the kill-shot is internally airtight.

quantitative_verification.claim: V12 SBA forward computation: 3,194 km predicted, ~11,800 km actual, error = (3194-11800)/11800 = -73%
quantitative_verification.check: Verified: |3194-11800|/11800 = 8606/11800 = 0.729 = 73% absolute, sign-correct (-73% directional). Earlier 78% value would imply ~2,600 km prediction (1-0.78)·11800=2596 — that was the deprecated V12 estimate before forward-computation cross-check.

summary_for_decider: VERIFICATION RESULT (q448): Both ISS-2463 self-apply sites (part5 ks-tldr idx 20773 + Summary idx 24828) landed verbatim at 73%. Part 5 is now internally consistent (4 occurrences of 73% on the SBA claim, zero 78%). BUT cross-section scan surfaces ONE residual: part8 §8.2 idx 1875 still reads "failed by 78% on Sydney–Buenos Aires in V12" — the same SBA-specific claim, missed by the ISS-2456 enumeration (which scoped §7.1, §6.10, Part5 body) and by the KILLSHOT-SH.c3 review (which scoped part5 only). RECOMMENDATION: open a follow-up ISS and self-patch part8.html idx 1875 "failed by 78%" → "failed by 73%". Single replace, no risk of unintended hits (the part8 surrounding pattern "The same formula failed by 78% on Sydney–Buenos Aires in V12" is unique). After that, all five SBA-specific sites read 73%, all four 25–78% dome-quoted range citations remain unchanged (correct), and the kill-shot is internally airtight. No new inconsistencies introduced by ISS-2463 itself.
